skill_name: Describe the benefits of virtual reality in healthcare
workflow: Virtual reality is revolutionizing the healthcare industry by providing an immersive and engaging experience for patients. It has the potential to reduce stress and anxiety, decrease pain and discomfort, and increase patient mobility. It also provides an opportunity for improved doctor-patient communication and connection.
